x-document-authoring.format: Markdown GFM; no raw HTML, CSS or remote images
x-document-authoring.presentation: Server-independent platform renderer shared by UI, API and CLI imports
x-document-authoring.sequence: body is context only; put emails exclusively in variants[].steps[] with plain-text subject, Markdown body and relative delayDays. Do not duplicate email tables in body.
x-document-authoring.icpAndStrategy: Use descriptive level-2 headings, short paragraphs and simple tables. Recommended opening: En bref. Do not invent missing facts.
x-document-authoring.compatibility: Recommended headings are not mandatory; existing documents and revisions are preserved.

info.description: Contrat fournisseur-neutre de l'agent Hermès. Limite globale des corps JSON: 8 Mio. Les écritures externes sont idempotentes; réutiliser une clé uniquement pour une requête identique. Une erreur 5xx transitoire se réessaie avec attente exponentielle et jitter. Le nom public d'un batch est Liste; /batches reste stable pendant v1.

body.description: Markdown content. No mandatory headings. Raw HTML and external images are not rendered.

DocumentSave.description: ICP and Persona are one category: create with icp; preserve persona for legacy edits. No parent required. The icp list filter includes legacy personas. Sequence: 1–6 variants, each with 1–5 steps. Other kinds, including other, use Markdown body content and no variants. Variant IDs unique per document; step IDs unique within variant. Links must reference same-workspace ICP or legacy Persona documents. Saving creates a new immutable content revision in draft.
